subject: Food Science
title: Umami Enhancers
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Umami Enhancers.

hook.text: The global umami seasoning market is worth $7 billion. Glutamate, nucleotides, and yeast extract are in processed food everywhere.

buildup.text: MSG adds glutamate. Inosinate (IMP, from meat) and guanylate (GMP, from mushrooms) are nucleotides that amplify umami perception.

discovery.text: Combining MSG with IMP or GMP multiplies umami intensity up to 8 times. It's called umami synergy.

twist.text: Yeast extract (Vegemite, Marmite) is labeled as 'natural flavoring' but provides the same glutamate as MSG.

climax.text: Kelp, dried bonito, aged parmesan, and soy sauce all achieve umami naturally. Industrial enhancers replicate what traditional.

punchline.text: Umami synergy: combine glutamate and nucleotides, get 8 times the flavor.

quiz.question: What is umami synergy?
